messages:
clare: Quick sync — landing + press + SI handoff. We have 48h to lock assets. Who can confirm final hero copy and embargo window?
aj: I can take hero copy. will push draft in an hour. need the final CTA from product.
maria: CTA is 'Try Redwood Inference — 14-day free dedicated trial'. ok to use?
aj: yup that's the one. thanks.
clare: sweet. embargo windows: press asked for Tue 09:00 PT, but SI leads want staging cutover Mon evening for partner demos. potential conflict. thoughts?
sam: we should do a soft staging cut Mon 20:00 PT and set the press embargo Tue 09:00 PT. ops can keep a hotfix lane if anything leaks.
jordan: +1 to soft staging. also need HW partner image assets (rack photos) — vendor legal still approving logo usage.
clare: @legal-bot any ETA on HW logo approval?
legal-bot: Legal: reviewing vendor logo TOU. Expect approval by Mon 16:00 PT if no redlines. Flagging trademark usage in US/EU locales.
maria: good call. localization: we need banner translations for en, fr, de, ja. engineering said 24h turnaround once copy is final.
aj: i'll send final strings to localization by 11:30 PT. can we compress to 18h?
sam: might be tight but feasible if localization team gets the files immediately. i'll ping them now.
clare: SI onboarding checklist (short):
```
- partner tenant provisioned
- test dataset loaded (anonymized)
- integration runbook & health checks verified
- demo scripts validated with new hero prompts
- support rotation assigned
```
clare: Anyone see missing items?
jordan: add 'HW compatibility smoke test' — power/thermal checks for partner racks.
aj: add 'press landing validation' — ensure telemetry and consent banners present.
maria: and 'embargo watermark' on staging snapshots for partners.
clare: Nice. Ops: sam can you own cutover schedule and rollback plan?
sam: will do. draft schedule by EOD. rollback plan: snapshot + traffic switch, ETA 15m.
clare: Press assets: hero image, partner logos (pending), exec quote, 2 customer blurbs. press-bot do we have embargo template?
press-bot: Press: embargo template ready. I'll attach to the PR. Please add exec quote by 14:00 PT tomorrow.
jordan: i'll chase partner PM for logo signoff now.
legal-bot: Legal: small note — any customer blurbs need signed ok from the customer before publishing. Don't publish without consent.
maria: noted. i'll send consent request emails this afternoon.
clare: One more: monitoring hooks. GA, amplitude, and a lightweight uptime check on the landing route before press release.
sam: already wired GA + amplitude. adding uptime probe cron. will post check URL once live.
aj: draft hero copy pushed: "High-throughput LLM inference, consistent across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
clare: Nice. can we make it more product-guided? maybe add 'production-ready'
aj: updated: "Production-ready LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
jordan: that reads strong. approved from my side pending logo.
clare: OK next steps: aj finalizes hero + CTA, maria runs localization and consent, sam owns cutover/monitoring, jordan chases logo, legal final signoff Mon 16:00. If all green, soft staging Mon 20:00 PT, embargo Tue 09:00 PT.
maria: I'll post a short checklist DM to each partner with timelines.
sam: will also schedule a 30m dry-run Tue 06:00 PT with SI demos.
clare: awesome. if anything changes ping this thread. :rocket:
